section_summary.extract_value: This section reports testing of a mediation model where psychological constructs (e.g., OISO experiences, broad conceptualization of beauty, body appreciation, and intuitive eating) were modeled as latent variables and analyzed controlling for age, BMI, and time on QQ. The authors trimmed a non-significant path (OISO to body appreciation), retained the trimmed model after chi-square difference testing, and found that broad conceptualization of beauty partially mediated the relation between OISO experiences and intuitive eating (indirect effects reported).
section_summary.evidence_source: Quoted sentences from the section: "First, the psychological variables were represented as latent variables indicated by the multiple items from their questionnaire measures." "Model fit data are presented in Table 2. The proposed model demonstrated good fit across multiple criteria. One path, OISO experiences to body appreciation, was not significant. To obtain a more parsimonious model, the path was deleted and the model was reexamined." "In support of our hypothesis, broad conceptualization of beauty partially mediated the relationship between OISO experiences and intuitive eating (indirect effect β = −0.066, SE = 0.028, p < .05)."

section_summary.extract_value: This section reports testing of a mediation model (controlling for age, BMI, and QQ use) where broad conceptualization of beauty partially mediated the relationship between online interpersonal sexual objectification experiences (OISOE) and intuitive eating (indirect effect β = −0.066, SE = 0.028, p < .05). The path from OISOE to body appreciation (BA) was non-significant and removed, and after trimming the model the retained model did not differ from the original (chi-square difference test with WLSMV); therefore BA was not examined as a mediator.
section_summary.evidence_source: "In support of our hypothesis, broad conceptualization of beauty partially mediated the relationship between OISO experiences and intuitive eating (indirect effect β = −0.066, SE = 0.028, p < .05)." and "Because the path from OISO experiences to body appreciation was found to be non-significant and deleted, we did not examine whether body appreciation mediated the path between OISO experiences and intuitive eating."
